uiAudioSourceReview.method: Read-only inspection of the relevant UI/audio integration sources and their bounded Git diffs.

recognitionAndRawStrokePoints.evidence: Audio observes drawing and summon-presentation lifecycle events. HUD observes state. No reviewed UI/audio hook writes recognition results or raw stroke-point collections. BrushStrokeFeedAdapter reads screen points and an ink snapshot for visual projection only.

inkCost.evidence: HUD/audio paths display or sonify existing ink and cast state. The visual feed's ComputeInk uses an ink snapshot to choose visual density; it does not debit or modify the gameplay ink pool.

damageFormulas.evidence: CombatLoopWiring emits audio-facing cast, hit, and parry notifications after existing accepted outcomes. Its reviewed UI/audio additions do not change damage arithmetic; the actual hit still applies the existing pending power.

sessionInteractions.evidence: WorldMacroPlaytestSession exposes current HUD text, suppresses legacy HUD only while the presenter is active, and emits InteractionResolved after accepted interactions. These hooks do not alter interaction costs or rewards.

healthHudRefresh.evidence: CombatLoopWiring subscribes RefreshHud to PlayerVitals.HpChanged so both damage and restore refresh presentation. It does not change HP mutation or damage formulas.

limits: Byte preservation is established only for the four files enumerated by before_manifest.json.
Supplier originals and other assets absent from before_manifest.json were not hashed by this audit and are not claimed verified.
The source review is limited to UI/audio integration hooks in the listed files. It does not certify unrelated pre-existing working-tree changes or the entire repository.

Some listed common-service files contain broader pre-existing changes relative to repository HEAD; this result only concludes that the bounded UI/audio hook additions do not alter recognition, raw-point storage, ink cost, or damage formulas.
The Playtest scene is expected to differ byte-for-byte. This audit does not assess its serialized content correctness.
No Unity import, compilation, runtime, audio playback, or visual validation was performed.
